result.topic_en: Euler tabulates values of x, y for which xy(xx−yy) has given non-square factor F, conjectures that every prime (or its double, or both) other than 2 occurs as such F, and gives a particular solution of pq(pp−qq) = n·xy(xx−yy)·square.
result.transcription:
Fragmenta ex Adversariis depromta. 251

Erit ergo $2r+s=\sqrt{(4pp-3ss)}=2p-\frac{fs}{g}$, unde $\frac{p}{s}=\frac{ff+3gg}{4fg}$.
Sumatur ergo $p=q=ff+3gg$ et $s=4fg$ eritque
$2r+s=2r+4fg=\pm 2(ff+3gg)-4ff$, hincque vel $r=3gg-ff-2fg$, vel $r=3(gg-ff)-2fg$.
Varii numeri formae $xy(xx-yy)$, qui eosdem factores non quadratos involvunt, sub littera $F$ contentos, in hac tabella exhibuntur:

F | x | y
2.3 | 2 | 1
 | 25 | 24
2.3.5.7 | 5 | 2
 | 6 | 1
 | 8 | 7
2.3.5.11 | 6 | 5
 | 8 | 3
 | 27 | 22
2.7.11 | 9 | 2
 | 18 | 7
3.5.7.11 | 11 | 4
 | 16 | 5

Conjectura. Posito $xy(xx-yy)=A^2F$, inter numeros $F$ videntur omnes numeri primi, vel ipsi, vel eorum dupla, vel ambo interdum occurrere, excepto scilicet binario, uti ex hac tabula colligere licet:

F | x | y
2.3 | 2 | 1
5 | 5 | 4
7 | 16 | 9
2.7 | 9 | 7
2.11 | 50 | 49
13 | 325 | 36
2.17 | 9 | 8
2.19 | 1250 | 289
23 | $156^2$ | $133^2$
2.23 | 121 | 23
29 | $29.13^2$ | $70^2$
31 | 1600 | 81

Problema. Invenire numeros $p, q, x, y$, ut sit $pq(pp-qq)=nxy(xx-yy)\square$, pro quolibet numero dato $n$.
Solutio tantum particularis tradi potest, et calculis satis molestis expeditis inveni sequentes valores
$p=s^4-20nsstt-8nnt^4$ \quad $p+q=2(ss-ntt)(ss-4ntt)$
$q=(ss+2ntt)(ss+8ntt)$ \quad $p-q=6ntt(5ss+4ntt)$
$x=s^4-20nsstt-8nnt^4$ \quad $x+y=(5ss+4ntt)(ss-4ntt)$
$y=4(ss-ntt)(ss+2ntt)$ \quad $x-y=3ss(ss+8ntt)$.
Hic enim rejectis factoribus quadratis formula $xy(xx-yy)$ omnes continet factores alterius $pq(pp-qq)$, ac praeterea factorem $n$ haec posterior continebit. Notandum hic est numerum $n$ tam positive quam negative accipi posse. Deinde etiam valores singularum harum litterarum semper positivi capi possunt, etiamsi prodeant negativi.

Only a particular solution can be given.
